content:
Earlier, WhatsApp launched a limited version of reaction emojis for the first time on Apple Watch, and the app is now starting to support all emojis on watchOS. Here are the details.

WhatsApp 擴展 watchOS 反應表情符號功能

At the end of last year, WhatsApp launched a full-featured Apple Watch app supporting call notifications, voice messages, chat history and reaction emojis.

This update is good news for Apple Watch users, especially as WhatsApp's presence on watchOS has been quite limited until now, relying almost entirely on system notifications to read and reply to messages.

However, the reaction emoji feature has always had one obvious limitation: users could only choose from six preset emojis. To use other emojis, they had to pick up their iPhone.

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is now starting to support all emojis on watchOS. The site points out that long-pressing a message will still show six preset reactions, but users can now open a larger picker containing recently used options as well as the full system emoji library, arranged by category.

Here's the report from WABetaInfo:

The site noted that although the feature has now officially launched, it could still take several weeks to roll out to all users, as WhatsApp is known for its gradual rollouts.
